messages:
jess_customer: Hi team — tried to apply the promo code from our onboarding email, UI shows it as valid, but checkout API responds 410. Can you help? Screenshot: https://img.example.com/reciept.png

maria_support: Sorry about that, @jess_customer. Can you paste the exact API request you used? Also which account/org id?

jess_customer: org_id=org_90321. Request:```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/checkout/apply_promo \\
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx' \\
  -d '{"promo_code":"WELCOME2026","account_id":"org_90321"}'
```

Response:```
{
  "error": {
    "type": "promo_error",
    "code": 410,
    "message": "Promo code invalid or expired"
  }
}
```

maria_support: thanks. Does the user see the code as "Available" in the dashboard promo page?

jess_customer: yes — dashboard shows 1 available and expiry 2026-12-31. They redeemed once for a seat then we transferred billing to a new org alias and now it errors.

maria_support: @ingrid_engineer can you check promo-service logs for org_90321 around the transfer window? Could be alias->account binding issue. :thinking_face:

ingrid_engineer: seen. There's a spike of 409/410 mappings right after the org-transfer job at 2026-03-03T02:12:07Z. Quick grep shows the promo token mapping in the promo-db used the old primary_email hash as part of the key. When billing alias swapped, the lookup failed (falls back to 410).

ingrid_engineer: repro steps I used locally:
1) create promo grant tied to email alice@oldcorp.com
2) transfer account -> new org_alias (billing_email=alice@newcorp.com)
3) call apply_promo with account_id referencing new org -> returns 410

logs snippet:```
[2026-03-03T02:12:07Z] promo-service INFO lookup_key=promo:WELCOME2026:email:alice@oldcorp.com -> grant_id=g_9987
[2026-03-03T02:12:07Z] billing-job INFO migrated_alias=alice@newcorp.com for org=org_90321
[2026-03-03T02:12:08Z] promo-service WARN lookup_key=promo:WELCOME2026:email:alice@newcorp.com -> not found -> respond 410
```

ingrid_engineer: root cause is promo table partitioning by email alias. Our org-transfer pipeline updates billing table but does not rewrite promo lookup keys.

maria_support: thanks @ingrid. What's the remediation plan and ETA? Customer is blocked on onboarding credits.

ingrid_engineer: short term: run migration to rewrite promo lookup keys for affected grants for org_90321. I'll run a targeted script and verify. Medium term: change lookup to use account_id (stable) and backfill mappings.

sam_billing: I can manually grant a one-off credit while engineering runs the fix. What amount should we grant?

jess_customer: equivalent to the original promo (USD 200 credits) would be perfect.

sam_billing: done. I created grant_manual@g_9987_manual for org_90321, 200 USD credits. Please verify in dashboard.

jess_customer: confirmed — credits visible in dashboard now. Thanks! :tada:

ingrid_engineer: migration script completed for org_90321 at 2026-03-03T04:05:12Z. Re-ran apply_promo call and got 200 with applied promo object.

maria_support: closing the loop. Root cause: promo lookup keyed to email alias that changed during org transfer. Actions: (1) manual credit by billing (done), (2) targeted backfill migration (done), (3) ticket opened to change lookup to account_id + backfill for all recent transfers. Ticket: https://internal.redwood.ai/tickets/INC-14567

deploy-bot: Scheduled task triggered: promo-lookup-backfill-job queued (job_id=bkfill-14567)

maria_support: @jess_customer sorry again for the friction, and thanks for the quick verification. Reach out if anything else pops up. :heart:

jess_customer: all good, appreciate the fast turnaround!"
